article.title: What can Italy do with its wealth?
article.excerpt: Italian private debt is quite low and yesterday I mentioned that Italian homeowners don’t have much in the way of mortgages. David Henderson then asked a good question : “Were more Italians to take out mortgages on their houses to buy government bonds, for example, Italy could eliminate its interest-payment problem.” How is that good news?
